items.name: Catch & Shoot: Fishing Game
items.description:
Catch the fish. Watch it jump. Take the shot.

Catch & Shoot: Fishing Game brings fishing and midair target shooting together in short 3D sessions. Cast your line, hold to reel in a fish and manage the line tension. When it leaps from the water, aim and shoot before it gets away.

Discover 10 different fish and fill your Fish Collection. Each new catch reveals a collection card, while repeat catches add to your total and bring you closer to unlocking another weapon.

Ready for a faster challenge? In Timed Shoot, fish jump from the water one after another. Choose a 30 or 60-second round, land a

items.name: Happy Trays: Sushi Sort Puzzle
items.description:
Welcome to Happy Trays, the sushi sort puzzle where every roll finds its tray!

Tap a plate of sushi rolls to send it to the sushi bar. The knife slices each roll, and every slice goes to the customer whose tray matches its color. Fill every tray, keep the line moving and serve every hungry customer.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a plate on top of the pile to move it to the sushi bar
• Each sushi roll is sliced and served to the customer of the same color
• The bar only has a few free spots - fill it up and the level is lost
• Uncover the plates underneath and plan every move

items.name: Warlords of the Three Kingdoms
items.description:
The Han is falling. Warlords carve the land. Your first duty is to put down the Yellow Turbans.

Warlords of the Three Kingdoms is a text RPG for the few minutes you have: run a campaign, collect from your cities and territories, raid a rival, and the day's orders are done.

RAISE SIXTY SIX GENERALS
Guan Yu, Zhuge Liang, Lu Bu, Cao Cao, and sixty two more, each with a portrait painted for the game. Recruit them in the Tavern, win them on campaign, or petition the Court. Star them up with their shards.

ARM THEM AND FILL THEIR RANKS
Arm each General with a weapon, armor, a mount, and two treasu

items.name: Wiggle Royale: Snake Arena
items.description:
Eat. Grow. Swallow smaller snakes. Beat the boss!

Wiggle Royale is a bright, bouncy 3D snake battle. You start as a tiny noodle in an arena full of hungry rivals. Gobble glowing orbs to grow thicker and longer, swallow snakes smaller than you, and stay away from the big ones. Only the biggest snake rules the arena!

THE BOSS CLASH
When the clock hits zero, the arena flashes white and the BOSS drops from the sky. The bigger snake wins, so grow fast! Beat the level 200 boss and the next one waits at 400, then 600 and beyond. Face four different bosses, each with its own trick: the Inferno Drago

items.name: 三國幻想錄:開局送5星關羽
items.description:
黃巾亂起，朝野動盪，大漢江山分崩離析。天下豪雄趁勢而起，諸侯割據四方，戰火蔓延城郭鄉野。梟雄懷吞併天下之志，義士抱匡扶社稷之心，無數武將謀臣登場，譜寫一段段可歌可泣的亂世傳奇。在這風雲變幻的時代，你將作為一方勢力的掌權者，招攬四海豪傑，籌劃軍策，征戰四方，書寫屬於你的三國霸業。

離線掛機躺收資源，告別爆肝刷本；抽中新武將即可直接上陣，無需耗費資源重複培養。打破品質束縛，所有武將皆可突破至無雙境界，無論蓋世名將，或是冷門文臣武吏，只要是你心儀的角色，都能成為隊伍核心主 C。

【幻想亂世・群賢匯聚】
百餘位三國武將經過全新美術演繹，魏、蜀、吳、羣四方豪傑盡數登場。於酒館邂逅各路名將，解鎖武將專屬傳記，窺見英雄背後不為人知的故事，沉浸式感受波瀾壯闊的漢末風雲。

【離線放置，輕鬆征伐天下】
主線闖關全自動戰鬥，離線掛機持續產出金幣、裝備、各類養成素材。上線一鍵領取全部累積收益，利用碎片化時間就能實力進階。閒暇之餘掛機養成，空閒時間調整隊伍陣容，無需耗費大量時間反覆刷關。

【策略佈陣，自由搭配陣容】
不局限傳統強力國家隊，高自由度陣容隨意組合。武將羈絆連攜、神兵秘寶、戰魂加持、站位博弈，不存在一套通吃全關卡的萬能隊伍。依據敵方陣容靈活調整武將，無損切換隊員，巧謀克敵，以智謀決勝沙場。

【多元玩法，飽覽三國風華】
闖關試煉、秘境探險、跨服演武、群雄擂台、軍團混戰等豐富內容。PVE 闖

items.name: Unlatched
items.description:
Somewhere in every lock there’s a latch, and something is holding it. Your job is always the same: find what, and take it away.

Each of the 101 locks in Unlatched is a little machine, sketched in pencil and washed with watercolour, as if lifted from an inventor’s notebook. At first it’s a pin and a cam. Soon you’re holding one part with one finger while you coax another with the other, watching a spring wait for its moment, or lifting a block out of the way and wondering where it will be useful. Every lock plays fair: nothing happens that you can’t see, and when it opens, you know exactly why

items.name: GravityCrush
items.description:
Mr. Capital wants the largest, best galaxy for himself. Naturally, he sent you—and a hungry little black hole—to collect the building blocks.

Steer through living solar systems. Grow large enough to swallow rocky worlds, gas giants and eventually stars — but plan your path carefully. Fling away too much matter or drift too close to something bigger than you, and your cosmic shopping trip may end early.

EXPLORE THE UNIVERSE
• Conquer handcrafted levels across the galaxies
• Navigate binary suns, asteroid belts, rogue planets, supernovas and more
• Face new hazards as your journey grows more d

items.name: Slidante: Music Sliding Puzzle
items.description:
A sliding puzzle you solve by ear.

Every tile plays a fragment of a melody. Listen, slide the tiles into order, and hear the tune come back together. When the whole line sounds right, you’ve solved it.

MUSIC
• 7 original melodies: a waltz, a march, a lullaby and more — 3 free and 4 with Premium
• 2×3 and 3×3 boards
• Three ways to play: with notes, with the outline of the tune, or by ear alone
• Listen for free as often as you like, plus three hints when you get stuck
• Every melody you collect is kept tile by tile — replay it or share its card
• A new melody of the day, free and the same fo

items.name: Time Legion
items.description:
The Iron Legion has broken loose in time. Your squad, the Time Legion, goes after them.

Time Legion is a fast army runner. Your soldiers march up the road on their own. You steer them left and right, and they fire at everything in front of them. Shoot the right gates to add more soldiers. Avoid the wrong ones. Cross chasms on bridges, dodge spikes and blades, and keep your squad alive until the finish line.

Every fifth level a boss blocks the road. Dragons, clockwork knights, steam juggernauts, zeppelins, giant tanks and a titan mech. Each one fights in its own way.

SIX ERAS, 90 LEVELS
- Th

items.name: Mad Guess: Mystery Puzzles
items.description:
Every case in Mad Guess is a small mystery you can crack in a few minutes. Read the evidence, spot the detail that doesn't fit, and name the answer. One case, one right answer, and a real "got it" moment every time.

READ THE EVIDENCE
A letter from 1985. A boatyard receipt. A postcard with a stamp you should look at twice. A family group chat where everyone swears it wasn't them. Every clue looks like the real thing, and every fact you need is in front of you.

SPOT WHAT DOESN'T ADD UP
No hidden objects, no timers, no luck. Just careful reading and a little logic. Pick a suspect, a year, a pla

items.name: Мафия (Новая)- игра с друзьями
items.description:
ИГРАЙ ОДИН ИЛИ СОБИРАЙ ДРУЗЕЙ
Начни партию против ботов или передавай один телефон по кругу в режиме «Вечеринка». Приложение раздаёт тайные роли, ведёт смену дня и ночи и помогает провести голосование.

12 РОЛЕЙ — РАЗНЫЕ ПУТИ К ПОБЕДЕ
Мирный житель, Мафия, Дон, Комиссар, Доктор, Маньяк, Любовница, Телохранитель, Журналист, Снайпер, Оборотень и Бессмертный. Изучай досье персонажей и подбирай состав под свою компанию.

ШЕСТЬ РЕЖИМОВ ПРОТИВ БОТОВ
• Классика — от 6 до 16 участников, свой набор ролей и три уровня сложности.
• Блиц — короткие обсуждения и 15 секунд на голос.
• Рейтинговая — закрытые

items.name: Brewmora
items.description:
Welcome to Brewmora! Join Luna, a young witch, and her cat Miso: sort colourful potions into bottles, brew recipes and wake sleeping magical worlds one step at a time.

HOW TO PLAY Tap a bottle, then tap the bottle to pour into. Potions only stack on the same colour. Finish the level when every bottle holds a single colour. Easy to start, deeper the more you think.

A LIVING WORKSHOP Every bottle you complete earns a potion. Brew recipes with your potions and watch the workshop transform: plants sprout, crystals wake, candles light up, the magic circle glows and the cauldron starts to bubble.

items.name: Organization: Shadow Rule
items.description:
A small neighborhood gang, a single country and one big goal: rule the world from the shadows before the Interpol File fills up.

Organization is a strategy game of expansion played on a world map. Spread your organization from its home country to its neighbors, then by sea and by air to distant continents. On a map of 90 regions, every move brings you power, but every move also leaves a trace.

GROW YOUR ORGANIZATION
Choose from 100 skills across the Network, Operations and Shield tabs. Open land, sea and air routes, boost your income and shore up your defenses. Put the right skills together

items.name: Doorway Surfers
items.description:
Grab the bars, rookie. The orders are piling up.

DOORWAY SURFERS is a one-thumb bike-courier game set in a hand-inked street-art world. Weave through traffic, swerve around opening car doors, squeeze past protest marches and food carts, then deliver the order the only way a real courier would: straight through the customer's front door.

ONE THUMB, FULL SPEED
• Keep your thumb on the screen and drag to steer. Holding on means pedaling, fast.
• Corners don't turn for you: drag into every turn, or run wide into the curb.
• Barrier across the road? Swipe down to slide right under it at full spee

items.name: Ramp n Roll
items.description:
Flick a wooden ball up the lane. It hits the hop, sails into the rings and rattles round a hoop. Lights chase, the display yells at you, and a ribbon of paper tickets spits out of the machine. Spend them at the prize counter on ridiculous junk that makes you better. Then go again.

Ramp n Roll is a silly, loud, satisfying pixel-art arcade game. A round is nine balls and about two minutes. A sitting can be one round or a whole evening.

FLICK IT
Swipe to throw: how fast and which way you swipe is how hard and where it goes. Bank shots off the rails, sink the corner 100s, and catch a weak throw

items.name: Rexdoku
items.description:
Un dinosaure par ligne, par colonne et par couleur, sans que deux dinosaures se touchent, même en diagonale ! Bienvenue dans Rexdoku, le jeu de logique où chaque dinosaure doit trouver sa place.

OBSERVEZ, ÉLIMINEZ, RÉSOLVEZ
Lisez les régions colorées, marquez les cases impossibles avec des empreintes et placez vos dinosaures. Les trois règles sont simples à comprendre ; trouver la bonne combinaison demande de l'observation et de la déduction.

items.name: FeltDot: Pixel Art Puzzle
items.description:
A cozy felt puzzle to relax with: welcome to FeltDot.

FeltDot is a relaxing pixel art puzzle game where you tap coloured balls to finish the picture. Tap a group of same-colour felt balls, then tap the spot where that colour belongs. That's it. The balls fly over and poke into place, and the pixel picture comes back one cell at a time. If you love colour sort and ball sort puzzles, you'll feel right at home.

■ Two taps, easy to play
· Tap a group, then tap a spot. The felt balls settle in one after another.
· Matching spots that touch at a corner fill in the same move.

items.name: Planet Pop: Farflung Roguelike
items.description:
Name a country that borders Brazil. Name one with a red and white flag. Every question has loads of right answers, and the rarer your pick, the more it scores

Planet Pop is an endless geography quiz on a toy globe, built like a roguelike. You start every run with 3 lives, and when the last one is gone you go again, chasing a higher score. Every run is different

items.name: Hop Cup
items.description:
Place wooden ramps, bouncy rubber pads, and seesaws to bounce the ball cleanly into the porcelain cup.

Hop Cup is a handcrafted tactile physics puzzle toy built for calm, satisfying trick shots — with zero ads, zero energy timers, and 100% offline play.

FEATURES
• 48 Handcrafted Puzzles across 4 chapters: Wooden Desk, Rubber Bounce, Brass Pegboard, and Seesaw Workshop
• Fresh Daily Cup: A brand-new verified physics puzzle every single day of the year

items.name: Ladybug Pairs – Match for Kids
items.description:
Ladybug Pairs is a calm matching game for children aged 3 to 5 – like the wooden pairs game from the playroom, with Dotty the ladybug as a friendly companion.

FREE TO PLAY
5 worlds and the ladybug token are free. A one-time purchase in the parent area unlocks dinosaurs, space, pets and the leaf token, forever and for every profile. New worlds and tokens from future updates are included.

items.name: Curly Cats: Cat Escape Puzzle
items.description:
Tap. Wiggle. Purr.

The curly cats have tied themselves in knots, and only you can get them out!

Tap a cat and it curls forward along its body. If the way is clear, it escapes with a happy meow. If someone's in the way… bonk! Read which way every cat is facing, plan your moves and free them all.

COLLECT, DECORATE, PLAY EVERY DAY
• Collect 16 adorable cats, from Mango the ginger to legendary Cosmo
• Earn coins and decorate five cozy cat homes: a café, a rooftop garden, a treehouse, a greenhouse and a sakura tea house
• Daily Puzzle: the same tangle for everyone in the world. Share your time!

items.name: Yadigar: Tamir Atölyesi
items.description:
Yadigâr, eski eşyaları inceleyip tamir ettiğin sakin bir restorasyon ve bulmaca oyunu.

items.name: LCM: Football Club Manager
items.description:
A football manager that fits in your pocket. Take charge of a club, decide the line-up and tactics, follow the match live and, above all, buy and sell players. A whole round takes just a few minutes.

REAL LEAGUES AND CLUBS 21 leagues, from the Czech top flight to Europe's big five. Real clubs, stadiums and players, with the data updating itself once a month.

LIVE MATCHES A 2D pitch, minute-by-minute commentary, stats, substitutions and tactical changes during the game. Play at 1×, 2× or 4× speed, or text only.

items.name: Flexina Run
items.description:
Race through a neon city in a three-lane arcade runner. Switch lanes, jump, roll under obstacles and trigger overclock at the right moment.

CHOOSE YOUR RUN
Play NORMAL, SLIDE, RUSH or MIRROR. Start on your board and chain rails in Slide. Rush speeds up the run; Mirror reverses your left and right controls. The daily challenge and League add their own courses and records.

EXPLORE 15 DISTRICTS
From the Docks to the Metro, the Canals, the Icefield and the Spaceport, each district has its own scenery and atmosphere. Your run earnings rebuild each district, one site at a time.

items.name: Pinball Cross
items.description:
Your phone is the controller. Your balance makes the difference.

Pinball Cross turns a rolling-ball course into a pinball playground. Tilt your phone to guide a chrome ball along suspended tracks, bounce off springy bumpers and find a clean line through every obstacle. Keep your nerve, collect tokens and reach the finish before the clock runs out.

48 COURSES. 8 WORLDS.

items.name: Miette: Absorption
items.description:
Miette is a robot the size of an ant. You guide her through a house full of bugs, one zone at a time: under the table, behind the outlet, inside the cabinet.

Fights are automatic. When Miette touches a bug, the fight starts on its own. If she wins, she absorbs part of its stats: ants give attack, pill bugs give defense, flies give speed. So you pick which bugs to fight based on what you want to build up.

Every fight costs energy. When it runs out, the run ends and the absorbed stats are lost. Your gear, keys, beacons, and skills stay, and the next run goes further.

items.name: Draw Infinite
items.description:
Zoom in. Find what's hidden.

Every level in Draw Infinite is one hand-drawn picture that never runs out of detail. Zoom into a planet and there's an island. Zoom into the island and there's a little town. Keep going, and there's a red house, a window, a cat asleep on the sofa and a goldfish in its bowl. Somewhere in all of it, a few small things are hiding. Find them all to win.

HOW TO PLAY
• Pinch to zoom in, or double-tap. Playing with one hand? Double-tap, hold and slide.
• The cards at the bottom show what to find, and how deep each one hides.

items.name: Find Kkorong: Hidden Traveler
items.description:
A bustling market. A sunny beach. A glowing night bazaar.
Somewhere among hundreds of people is Kkorong, a tiny traveler.

Teal backpack, orange pennant, sprout hair — use these clues to find Kkorong,
then find the people on your notes, like "someone in a straw hat holding a red balloon."
Every scene is alive: people walk, stop, and slip behind market stalls.

■ A NEW DAILY SCENE
Two or three minutes a day. Each weekday has its own twist:
Mon flashlight · Tue rain · Wed Kkorong in disguise · Thu five notes · Fri double speed · Sat story day · Sun friend challenge

■ CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS
Shar

items.name: Gobs & Gears
items.description:
The Gob King wants his bomb and he wants it NOW!

Gobs & Gears is a scrappy logistics puzzle where nothing is permanent. Scout the Fog, reclaim lost Buildings, run Trundler routes to feed them. Deliver the goods, then rip it all up and move on.

NOTHING'S PERMANENT. NOTHING'S WASTED.

Build the route that does the job. Then tear it all up, pocket the Salvage and move on to the next objective. Build it wrong? Good. That's half the fun. Rip up Trundlers, blow up Buildings, obliterate mountains and water, and build straight back up.

items.name: Puttfall: Golf on Your Wrist
items.description:
A golf course small enough to wear.

Pull back anywhere on the screen, let go, and off it flies. Over the pond, a bounce on the fairway, a little check on the green and a roll to the cup. Plink! Sink a birdie and a bird pops out of the hole to celebrate.

Puttfall is golf as a toy: a tiny, painted course that lives on your watch. One finger plays every shot. Pull further to hit harder, and a dotted line shows where the ball will land before you let go. The club picks itself, driver to putter, so all you choose is where and how hard. Mind the wind.

items.name: Thrifty Business
items.description:
There’s a brand new thrift store in town, and guess what? You’re in charge!

In Thrifty Business, you’ll set up and manage your very own 90’s-inspired vintage thrift shop. Search through boxes filled with pre-loved gems and use them to create gorgeous displays. Unlock furniture, decorations, wallpaper & floors to create a beautiful community space that brings everybody together!

Adjust your layout and organize your shelves and racks to the finest detail. Group your wares by colour, theme, purpose, or whatever you like. The more organized your store is, the more community points you’ll get to

items.name: OVERSEED
items.description:
Build a fleet of robot mowers, power it with solar and cut your way out to the edge of the land.

A FLEET THAT RUNS ITSELF
Mowers find their own lanes, drive home when the battery runs low and wait their turn at a busy charger. Drones spot the weeds, clear sticks and stones and carry stranded machines back. The fleet keeps working while you plan, and keeps earning a little while you're away. Whenever you feel like it, take the controls and drive a mower yourself.

POWER IS THE PUZZLE
Solar panels, cables and chargers decide how hard your fleet can work. Batteries are short, and clouds, rain an

items.name: Pixel | Sniper
items.description:
A busy city street. Somewhere in the crowd: red shirts. Take every one before the clock runs out.

Tilt the phone to aim. Tap to zoom in, tap to fire, swipe down to pull back and spot your next target. Every hit bursts into pixels. Never hit anyone who isn't wearing red.

MISSIONS: three contracts, each with its own story. A meeting at a mansion. A firefight on the docks where the guards shoot back. A man with a double, and only one of them carries the briefcase.

items.name: FishingDays: Pixel Fishing
items.description:
A cozy fishing trip across Japan with your Shiba.

Set out from Komorebi, a small fishing village between the mountains and the sea, and travel to waters all over Japan with your Shiba companion.
A laid-back fishing game drawn in pixel art.

- When the float dips, strike!
Tap the water to cast, and set the hook when the float goes under. Hook a big one and the screen shakes: "What a monster pull!"

-Over 250 real fish species
Sweetfish, char, yamame, black sea bream, red sea bream, bluefin tuna and more — all fish that really live in Japan's rivers, lakes and seas. Every catch goes into your f

items.name: Lær klokken med drager
items.description:
Lær klokken gennem leg i en farverig drageverden! Et dansk læringsspil til børn på 6–8 år, hvor barnet selv flytter viserne og lærer at forstå tiden – ét skridt ad gangen.

Vælg mellem tre drager, skriv et navn, og rejs gennem otte fantasifulde områder. Hvert niveau indeholder seks opgaver med tydelige instruktioner og dansk oplæsning.

DET LÆRER BARNET:
• At kende forskel på den lille og den store viser
• Hele og halve timer
• Kvart over og kvart i
• Fem-minutters intervaller
• Præcise minutter
• At forstå 12- og 24-timers tid
• At løse blandede klokkeopgaver

LÆR URET I DIT EGET TEMPO

Barne

items.name: Break Free: Maze Escape
items.description:
The exit is in sight. The route is full of danger.

Rotate the maze with the Digital Crown, navigate its twisting passages, avoid deadly spikes, and reach the glowing door. Each room challenges you to find a safe way through.

items.name: Lasso Tones
items.description:
A puzzle game where you draw ropes around pegs to steer falling balls into a goal. Every bounce plays a note on the beat, so each solution ends up sounding like its own little song.

DRAW, DROP, LISTEN
Press on a peg, drag a rope around others and let go to close the loop. Balls fall, bounce off your ropes and play them like instruments. Grab a rope to reshape it, or unwind it to try again.

• Slide: the ball hugs the rope and slides along it

items.name: Naipe: Card Logic Puzzle
items.description:
You are never dealt a hand. You deal the last card.

The table is set, every seat has its cards, and one slot is still empty. Your job is to choose which card goes there — and with that single choice, decide how the table ends.

HOW A LEVEL WORKS

items.name: OliBolis Twinkle Town
items.description:
Welcome to Twinkle Town, a cozy fairy village made for young kids!

Charlotte the fairy needs a home. Build her a wonky, wonderful house from mushroom roofs, petal doors and flower windows, then watch more fairy friends move in, each one bringing a new game.

EXPLORE THE VILLAGE MAP
- Visit the Wishing Well, Maple's Bakery, Owl's Question Tree, the Fishing Pond, the Pet Spa and more.
- Little daily surprises, and missing a day never costs anything.

- Feed, brush, bathe and play with each fairy's pet to fill its hearts and teach it tricks.

items.name: Sandfall: Sand Art Painting
items.description:
